faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLK 63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The CLK 63 AMG uses the M156 6.2-litre V8, fitted to the C209 generation from 2002 to 2009.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLK 63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLK 63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: All CLK 63 AMG models have the M156 engine code. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before quoting.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M156 CLK 63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, camshaft adjuster, and bearings as standard on every M156 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLK 63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLK 63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLK 63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLK 63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
